verdict.description: "clean" when the reviewed changes require no action before commit. An empty findings array is a valid and expected outcome.

summary.description: Two sentences at most, describing the state of the changeset overall.

id.description: Stable short id within this round, e.g. "F1".

title.description: One line, under 80 characters, stating the defect.

validation.description: Candidate validation state. Use unverified only for low-level initial review or an explicitly degraded no-delegation fallback; targeted verification findings are confirmed or plausible.

failure_scenario.description: Concrete input, state, timing, platform, divergence risk, or operational cost that makes the issue material.

body.description: Evidence that the issue is introduced or materially worsened by the reviewed changes, why it warrants action before commit, and the required direction for the fix.

repeat_of.description: When re-reporting a finding from a prior round, the prior round's finding id (e.g. "R1-F2"). Empty string when this is new.
